name: 排查远程电脑
tagline: Let an agent inspect another computer via Queqiao's local MCP controller.
description: Queqiao (鹊桥) skill named 排查远程电脑. It teaches an agent to install the local stdio MCP controller, ask the assisted person to share a complete connection credential, then inspect processes, services, and logs. The skill does not grant remote access by itself. Temporary credentials still require on-device approval for connect and for commands; unattended long-lived codes skip per-action prompts. The public website and relay are not a hosted MCP endpoint. The install command only works after this skill is pushed to https://github.com/CodeYuanG/queqiao.

install.notes: This is a skill, not a remote MCP listing. Queqiao's MCP server is a local stdio binary the skill helps install; do not configure http://121.196.45.81/ as a hosted MCP URL. The public cline skill install / npx skills add command requires the skill to already be on the default branch of CodeYuanG/queqiao.
